name: daily-notes
description: Keeps every dictation in a Markdown note per day.

description.en: Appends every dictation, with its time and app, to a Markdown note per day
description.zh-CN: 把每次听写连同时间和应用，追加到当天的 Markdown 笔记里

help.en: One file per day goes here, like 2026-10-31.md; ~ is your home folder
help.zh-CN: 每天一个文件放在这里，例如 2026-10-31.md；~ 表示主目录
